target_customer: Industrial sites in mining, marine, utilities and manufacturing that grease heavy machinery
problem: Incorrect greasing is a leading cause of machinery failure, and there was no way to verify that grease was applied to the right fitting in the right amount.
business_model: Hardware tags and grease gun sensors plus cloud software subscription (GreaseCloud)

founders.name: Steve Barnett
founders.background_notes: Had the original idea per Invest Sunshine Coast and Startup Daily. Not listed on the YC page. Education and employers not found.

founders.name: Tim Hall
founders.role: Founder, CEO per YC page, COO per Invest Sunshine Coast
founders.background_notes: YC page: experienced project manager with a mechanical engineering background. Titles conflict across sources.

competitors.name: SKF LRM2 lubrication remote monitor
competitors.what: Remote monitor for automatic lubrication systems, grease or oil

technical_complexity.rationale: Ruggedised wireless sensing hardware, tags on fittings and cloud software for harsh industrial sites. The company was on its fourth generation system by late 2021 with seven engineers.

defensibility.rationale: Patented system per Invest Sunshine Coast and installed tags and data history on customer machines. Large bearing and lubrication makers could build similar monitoring.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found. SKF and Schaeffler sell their own lubrication monitoring products.

market_need_then: The company cites incorrect greasing as the number one cause of machinery failure and a 21 billion dollar annual cost. First installation was at Glencore and clients came from mining, marine and utilities.

branding.domain_note: greaseboss.com.au redirects to greaseboss.io, so the company moved from an Australian domain to .io. Dates not found.

identity.visual_style: Industrial, shown with founders in hi-vis gear on mine sites
identity.voice_and_tone: Blunt and practical, treats greasing as a science

branding.brand_signature: Product family names GreaseBoss, GreaseCloud and Quickfit tags
branding.community_and_virality: Press from Startup Daily, Newcastle Herald, SmartCompany, Mining Magazine and a Product Hunt listing, mostly about the Joe Montana investment and YC.

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable, self-explanatory name with a consistent product naming family and national press, but no evidence of community or merch.

outcome_analysis: GreaseBoss is active. Founders came from mining, aerospace and robotics experience and found a first customer in Glencore. After YC it raised about 2.5M Australian dollars in October 2021 led by Pipeline Capital, with Joe Montana's Liquid 2 Ventures taking a stake, and later showed an IoT endpoint product. No later round, exit or shutdown found. The niche is real but narrow.
notes: Seed amount: Startup Daily headline says 2.5 million and Invest Sunshine Coast says about AU$2.5M raised to date, so amount_usd is left null because no USD figure is stated. A search snippet claimed a 4M seed in May 2021, seen in one place only and not recorded. The company site greaseboss.io and SmartCompany could not be fetched because the domain safety check was rate-limited. Founder titles conflict: YC page lists Tim Hall as CEO, Startup Daily and Invest Sunshine Coast list Steve Barnett as CEO. Founders education and employers not found. An outcome search found nothing about acquisition or shutdown.
